title: Cancel a booking
caption: Mirrors sso-bookings.e2e.ts (an airline-card booking ticketed today, voided). The step comes from the API's cancellationMode in storefront_settings.time_zone.

steps.title: Open the dialog
steps.expect: The Amadeus step in words: release (nothing ticketed), void (tickets issued today) or a request to the airline; the money choices of the payment.

steps.title: Fill it
steps.body: Choose a **Reason category** (e.g. The customer asked), type a reason, choose the money (none / full / amount), keep or untick the e-mail.
steps.expect: Airline card: only "No refund from the console" (the void reverses the airline's charge). Request to the airline: no refund choice.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.expect: Release/void: Cancelled. Request: "Cancellation requested from the airline: the booking is not cancelled yet." with the API's warning; Cancel no longer offered.

steps.title: Check the data
steps.body: `SELECT status, cancelled_by, cancel_reason FROM tenant_<key>.bookings WHERE id='<id>';`, `SELECT amount, reason, status FROM tenant_<key>.refunds WHERE booking_id='<id>';`
steps.expect: `cancelled / staff / customer_request: <reason>`; a refund row for a Stripe refund (none for an airline card); `booking.cancel` staff action with `mode`; Mailpit `booking.cancelled` (or `booking.cancellation_requested`).

steps.title: Edge: refund above what is left
steps.expect: "at most …" on the amount (the API's `details.refundable`); nothing cancelled.
